pattern.description: File glob relative to path. '*.ts' matches file names at any depth; 'src/*.ts' matches only direct files in the root's src; '**/src/*.ts' also matches direct files in nested src directories. A leading './' is ignored; './' alone is invalid.

path.description: Absolute directory path on the selected Environment. There is no implicit default. Results are relative to this directory.

limit.description: Maximum number of files to return (1 to 100000). Defaults to 1000 when omitted or 0.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive timeout in seconds. Defaults to 15.
